inputs.text: [serious] Herbivore, in a small group. [calm] It grazed on ground plants and bushes.
[curious] But what were the spikes actually for?
[hesitant] [pauses] Scientists still aren't sure. [curious] Maybe for defense, swinging its neck. Or maybe to stand out to other Amargasaurus.
[curious] And if nobody knows, how do you pick?
[gently] You don't pick. [calm] You share both ideas, and keep looking for the real answer.
